title: FBI Open Up
blurb: Splintering wood, shouted authority, and the implication that they were already outside while you were typing. The meme plays whenever somebody says, searches or asks something questionable, and the joke depends entirely on speed. The raid arrives before the sentence has finished. As a prank sound it is genuinely elite. Very few audio clips make a person physically turn and look at their own front door. Use a subwoofer for federal-grade impact, and be prepared to explain yourself to whoever you live with.
origin: The meme raid announcement, popularized by gaming and Discord culture.

es.title: FBI, Abran la Puerta
es.origin: El anuncio de redada del meme, popularizado por la cultura gamer y de Discord.
es.blurb: Madera astillándose, autoridad a gritos y la insinuación de que ya estaban afuera mientras tú escribías. El meme salta cada vez que alguien dice, busca o pregunta algo cuestionable, y el chiste depende por completo de la velocidad. El operativo llega antes de que termines la frase. Como sonido de broma es de élite genuina. Muy pocos clips de audio logran que una persona voltee físicamente a mirar su propia puerta. Usa un subwoofer para impacto de grado federal, y prepárate para dar explicaciones a quien viva contigo.
